concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 (cross‑validated performance ≥ 75 %) is not linked to any concrete verification task; no task asserts that the achieved CV score meets the threshold after the scientific run.

Success Criterion SC-002 (≥ 10 significant SNPs & metabolites) lacks a dedicated verification task; no task checks that the selected_features output satisfies the minimum count of significant biomarkers.
Success Criterion SC-003 (permutation test p‑value ≤ 0.05) is not covered by any verification task; there is no task that validates the permutation p‑value against the required threshold.

Success Criterion SC-004 (runtime ≤ 6 h, peak memory ≤ 7 GB) is not verified by any task; while T066 implements a resource monitor, no task asserts that the recorded usage stays within the specified limits.
